item.title: Memory makers sell out to 2029, a photonic switch for AI racks, and 5 new chip ideas
item.description: SK hynix and Samsung say AI memory is sold out for years. PsiQuantum shows a light-based switch for AI networks. Plus four more new papers and products, each scored.

item.title: From lab paper to profit: 12 AI-chip breakthroughs to watch before the market does
item.description: Stock prices react to earnings. Earnings come from factories. Factories come from papers and patents published years earlier. We read those first.
